narratives.Overview: PTBot is a two-pass parallel agent pipeline for precedent transaction analysis. It uses Oz local agents to discover M&A deals matching user-defined criteria (sector, geography, time window), filters to only deals with disclosed multiples, then deep-dives on qualified deals with deal-aware agents. Output is a QC-checked precedent transaction analysis in markdown, PDF, and IB-formatted Excel.
narratives.Architecture: Two-pass fan-out/fan-in pipeline built on top of attack.market's run_local_agent() helper. Pass 1 spawns 4 source-specialized scouts (press, filings, deal databases, analyst reports) in parallel. A compile/filter step deduplicates and filters to deals with disclosed multiples. Pass 2 spawns 3 deep-dive agents (target & terms, acquirer & rationale, comparable benchmarks) with the qualified deal manifest as input. A QC agent validates the compiled output, then PDF and Excel generators produce final deliverables. Installed as a standalone skill at ~/.agents/skills/precedent-transactions/ with a CLI launcher script.

items.title: Create two_pass_orchestrator.py with Pass 1 fan-out (4 source-specialized scouts), compile/filter step, and Pass 2 fan-out (3 deal-aware agents)

narrative.Acceptance: Pass 1 spawns 4 scouts in parallel via run_local_agent(). Compile step deduplicates candidates and filters to deals with multiples_disclosed=true. Pass 2 spawns 3 agents with qualified_deals.json as prompt context. All agents complete or gracefully degrade on timeout.

items.title: Implement QC agent stage with precedent-transaction-specific criteria

narrative.Acceptance: QC agent receives compiled Pass 2 output plus criteria from references/qc-criteria.md. Enforces: multiples present, geographic accuracy, date accuracy, source attribution, cross-section consistency. Produces qc_report.md and final_deliverable.md.

items.title: Create precedent_txns.py CLI with argparse for --sector, --geography, --start-date, --end-date, --min-multiples, --deal-size-min/max, --output-dir, --config-only, --timeout

narrative.Acceptance: CLI parses all arguments, builds scout and deep-dive prompts dynamically from parameters, calls two_pass_orchestrator. --config-only prints config JSON and exits without running.

items.title: Implement dynamic prompt generation that scales scout prompts for wider time horizons and different geographies

narrative.Acceptance: Scout prompts include geography-appropriate source names (e.g., Orlando Business Journal for Orlando, Crain's for Chicago). Time horizons >6 months instruct scouts to chunk by quarter. Pass 2 prompts include full deal names from qualified_deals.json.

items.title: Implement PDF generation from final_deliverable.md using fpdf2 with IB-style formatting (headers, footers, section breaks, clean typography)

narrative.Acceptance: PDF renders all sections from the deliverable template: executive summary, transaction table, deal profiles, comparable context, key takeaways. Unicode characters handled via sanitization. Page headers show report title and date.

items.title: Create generate_comps_excel.py that produces an IB-formatted precedent comps workbook from structured deal data

narrative.Acceptance: Excel workbook contains: Cover sheet, Comps Table (target, acquirer, date, deal value, EV/Revenue, EV/EBITDA, EV/ARR, P/E, structure), Benchmarks sheet, Sources sheet. IB color convention applied (blue=inputs, black=formulas, green=cross-sheet). Median/mean rows use formulas, not hardcoded values.

items.title: Write SKILL.md with trigger description, usage instructions, two-pass pipeline documentation, and CLI reference

narrative.Acceptance: SKILL.md frontmatter triggers on precedent transaction, M&A comps, deal comps, transaction multiples, acquisition research, and related phrases. Body documents the two-pass pipeline, CLI usage, output structure, and configuration options.

qc-criteria.md contains reusable QC criteria template with parameterized geography, date range, and sector. output-template.md defines the standard deliverable structure: executive summary, summary transaction table, detailed deal profiles, comparable multiples context, key takeaways.

items.title: Install skill to ~/.agents/skills/precedent-transactions/ and verify end-to-end with a test run

narrative.Acceptance: Skill directory structure matches plan. CLI runs without errors in --config-only mode. Full pipeline test completes with at least graceful degradation on all agents.
